Release 0.11.0 final receipts (all timestamps UTC).

Gerrit: change https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/1472, Change-Id If0e4948134800cd1619685b759f3f4dd193d8c19. Patchset 2 received LLM-Review +1 at 2026-08-07 06:30:15 and Verified +1 at 2026-08-07 06:42:41 from https://github.com/navapbc/rebar/actions/runs/31153786651; unresolved comments=0. Submitted at 2026-08-07 06:43:52. Gerrit/mirrored main commit is 43ecfa8f27165a80c90992fc80f514d1851931ce. This worktree fetched origin and rebased onto origin/main; git skipped the pre-submit patchset as already applied, and status is exactly release-0.11.0...origin/main.

Release workflow: dispatched release.yml from main with version=0.11.0 at 2026-08-07T06:45:02Z: https://github.com/navapbc/rebar/actions/runs/31155046833, head SHA 43ecfa8f27165a80c90992fc80f514d1851931ce. Required pypi environment deployment 5790112506 was approved at 2026-08-07T06:46:11Z. Every job completed success by 2026-08-07T06:49:00Z, including authorize, build-once, wheel/sdist tests, PyPI publish, GitHub Release, and MCP Registry.

PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/nava-rebar/0.11.0/. Wheel uploaded 2026-08-07T06:48:41.985340Z, SHA-256 521c8a08a58ae5581ad6cb51ba3a15de45f666615bb9a86ada68836ca16a1daf, URL https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/9c/2c/1c3cf6ecec72fd597736399b59ba4da0425448f2fe2e6ce5d78e9b4711c9/nava_rebar-0.11.0-py3-none-any.whl. Sdist uploaded 2026-08-07T06:48:43.744184Z, SHA-256 1f8ef8dbe0d19d441faf4563630212bae578a83c92df56e5a0cd05491bb124a5, URL https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/03/8d/3a50181d1924bc121cb405d41794eacfb28d4ec7d88220ef7f9a9e8a0199/nava_rebar-0.11.0.tar.gz. PyPI integrity API exposes the wheel provenance bundle. `uvx pypi-attestations verify pypi <wheel URL> --repository https://github.com/navapbc/rebar` returned `OK: nava_rebar-0.11.0-py3-none-any.whl`.

GitHub Release: https://github.com/navapbc/rebar/releases/tag/v0.11.0 published 2026-08-07T06:48:52Z, immutable, non-draft, non-prerelease, and returned by /releases/latest. Tag v0.11.0 resolves directly to 43ecfa8f27165a80c90992fc80f514d1851931ce. Attached wheel and sdist digests exactly match PyPI; SHA256SUMS is also attached.

MCP Registry: live registry query reports io.github.navapbc/rebar version 0.11.0 after successful workflow job https://github.com/navapbc/rebar/actions/runs/31155046833/job/92793288192.

Homebrew: triggered documented autobump https://github.com/navapbc/homebrew-rebar/actions/runs/31155335782; completed success at 2026-08-07T06:50:05Z. Commit https://github.com/navapbc/homebrew-rebar/commit/67b09c1e3819122a28398e20a8fb760645705770 updates Formula/rebar.rb to the exact PyPI 0.11.0 sdist URL and SHA-256 1f8ef8dbe0d19d441faf4563630212bae578a83c92df56e5a0cd05491bb124a5.

Channel probe: fresh isolated environment installed nava-rebar[mcp]==0.11.0 from PyPI (31 packages); scripts/probe_rebar.py drove that environment binary and reported `PROBE RESULT: 140 passed, 0 failed`.

Local/review evidence: version-lockstep and 36 release guard/workflow tests passed; focused late-upstream tests 4 passed; lint passed 1729 files; mypy passed 438 sources; full suite passed 10,865 with 38 skipped and 228 deselected; wheel/sdist build and Twine checks passed. Post-merge `uv lock --check` passes, version fields are all 0.11.0, and CHANGELOG 0.11.0 is dated 2026-08-06 with Unreleased/compare links.

Exception/rollback disposition: no release rollback or yank is warranted; published artifacts and all channels are healthy. The only exception was the runbook/AC use of GitHub SLSA tooling for PyPI PEP 740 provenance. rebar-debug proved the artifact valid with the authoritative PyPI verifier; follow-up bug 13b4-c597-200b-4e31 is linked discovered_from to correct docs/releasing.md and the workflow comment.
